newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Congress approves $1.1 bln extra money.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Congress approves $1.1 bln extra money.

text.p: Venezuela's Congress approved a government request to spend an extra 530 billion bolivars ($1.1 billion), 165 billion bolivars of which will go to pay foreign debts, legislators said.
The debt payments, which were not specified, will be the first to be made from a special fund created recently by the government to absorb windfall revenues from higher-than- expected oil prices.
Other recipients of the extra spending include a decentralization fund and public universities.
The request is the third approved by Congress this year following 765 billion bolivar and 324 billion bolivar approvals earlier in the year.
The additional spending requests have been backed largely by higher-than-expected oil revenues.

The government is expected to approach Congress shortly for approval for another 210 billion bolivars spending to pay off overdue debt payments from 1994 and 1995. This additional spending will be backed by revenues from a 750 million mark Eurobond issue successfully placed earlier this month.
